instruction: On the Desktop there are PNG images labeled pic1.png, pic2.png, and pic3.png. Add these three images to a new presentation, with each image on its own slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting 3 images in specific order: pic1.png, pic2.png, pic3.png. Evaluator uses MD5 hash matching to verify each slide contains the correct image. Verified with Python script that computes MD5 hashes of cache images and tests metric function against gold file.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Progressive scoring: 0.333 points per correctly placed image slide

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic mismatch: Instruction says 'add to a new presentation' but config opens existing PPTX file (4.3-Template_4.29.2016.pptx). This creates ambiguity about whether to create new presentation or modify existing one.

Slide count logic flaw: Metric line 22 checks 'if actual_slide_count != expected_count: return 0.0', requiring exactly 3 total slides. If the opened presentation already has slides, adding 3 image slides won't result in exactly 3 total slides, causing false negatives.

Slide position verification issue: Metric iterates through slides sequentially (line 35) checking if slides 0, 1, 2 match expected hashes. If existing presentation has N pre-existing slides, and agent adds 3 images as slides N, N+1, N+2, the metric checks wrong slides (first 3) instead of the newly added ones.

Coverage incomplete: Evaluator doesn't verify that ONLY pic1.png, pic2.png, pic3.png are added (not pic4.png, pic5.png, pic6.png which are also downloaded in config). If agent adds all 6 images, only first 3 would be checked.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Align instruction with config: Either change instruction to 'Add these three images as new slides to the presentation' OR change config to create a blank presentation instead of opening existing one.
Fix slide count logic: Instead of checking total slide count equals 3, verify that at least 3 slides exist with the expected images. Or track which slides are new vs pre-existing.

Fix slide position logic: Either (1) scan all slides to find matching image hashes regardless of position, or (2) if order matters, verify the LAST 3 slides match expected hashes (assuming images are appended), or (3) create truly new/blank presentation so slides 0-2 are guaranteed to be the added ones.
Add exclusivity check: Verify only the specified 3 images are present in the final presentation, not additional images like pic4/5/6.
